results.text: Usage of vildagliptin among patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus attending a public primary healthcare clinics in Kuala Selangor District, Selangor. Studies showed that vildagliptin can lower HbA1c levels by 0.8%-1%. However, there is limited data looking at vildagliptin use among suburban populations. The efficacy of vildagliptin use may differ among different populations, especially those with low socio-economic status.
